title: Sofronio Vasquez thanks Michael Bublé, Martin Nievera for support ahead of concert
summary: Philippines’ pride Sofronio Vasquez expressed his gratitude to fellow artists, including international music star Michael Bublé and veteran singer Martin Nievera, for the support they have extended…

blocks.text: Philippines’ pride Sofronio Vasquez expressed his gratitude to fellow artists, including international music star Michael Bublé and veteran singer Martin Nievera, for the support they have extended to him as he prepares for his first solo concert. Vasquez is staging an intimate show, called “Sofronio Vasquez: Live in Concert,” on Nov. 7 at the Proscenium Theater in Rockwell, Makati City, with special guests Ogie Alcasid, Bituin Escalante, Jonah, Jed Madela, and National Artist for Music Ryan Cayabyab.
